query: Best source-available license granting maximum freedom while preventing user monetization
assumptions: Maximum freedom means the broadest possible set of user rights (use, study, modify, redistribute, fork, create derivative works) absent the monetization restriction.
No-monetization is the user's primary monetization-related restriction, not specifically an anti-SaaS clause.
The user wants a single primary recommendation, not a comparative license catalog.
Licensor is a developer/team choosing a license for their own software (not evaluating a third-party codebase).
Recommendation must consider U.S. copyright law as the primary enforcement regime.
Heather Meeker's license family (PolyForm/BUSL/SSPL/Elastic) represents the de facto standard for source-available licensing as of 2026.
